notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch, no WAF/bot-block encountered. Checked full main-nav href list on homepage (products/*, content/*, footer links, locale links), sitemap.xml (576 URLs -- no bestseller-shaped entries), and probed candidate static routes /best-sellers/, /bestsellers/, /products/best-sellers/, /products/bestsellers/ directly: all returned HTTP 302 with an EMPTY Location header and 0-byte body, which is this CMS's soft-404 signature for a non-existent route (confirmed by contrast with the known-good /products/news/ returning a normal 200). Also used the site's own search (/search/?q=...) for 'bestseller', 'popular', 'trending', 'favorites', and 'top sellers': all returned 0 genuine bestseller-concept tiles; the only non-zero hits ('top sellers' -> 7 tiles) were literal word matches on unrelated product names (Top Pendant Cluster, Top Pendant Lamp, Stacked Storage System) containing 'top'/'stack', not a bestsellers merchandising concept. No 'Bestsellers'/'Best Sellers'/'Popular'/'Trending'/'Customer Favorites' link exists anywhere in the site's main nav, footer, or the plp-navigation category-pill bar (which lists: All, Accessories, Extras, Lighting, News, Outdoor, Product Families, Seating, Sofas, Storage, Tables -- an exhaustive, site-defined top-level taxonomy with no bestseller entry). Site has no separate Danish-language storefront (only /ar/ locale link found besides default en-US) so no local-language check was applicable. Conclusion: Muuto does not merchandise a Bestsellers-type PLP on its DTC site.
